import pandas as pd


def run(inputs: dict) -> dict:
    df = inputs["RATE_FEED"].copy()

    # Legacy cursor order: ORDER BY account_id, obs_date, obs_seq
    df = df.sort_values(
        by=["account_id", "obs_date", "obs_seq"],
        kind="mergesort"  # stable sort to mimic deterministic cursor traversal
    ).reset_index(drop=True)

    # Forward-fill rate within each account only (carry never crosses accounts)
    df["rate_filled"] = df.groupby("account_id")["rate"].ffill()

    # was_carried = 1 only when original rate was NULL and a prior non-null
    # rate existed within the same account (i.e., ffill produced a value).
    df["was_carried"] = (
        (df["rate"].isna()) & (df["rate_filled"].notna())
    ).astype("int64")

    # Preserve COALESCE semantics: if no prior rate exists, rate_filled stays NULL
    # (already guaranteed by ffill behavior).

    result = df[["account_id", "obs_seq", "obs_date", "rate_filled", "was_carried"]]

    return {"rate_filled": result}
